recognize_zh: CD3 染色中寬大的外套層區域幾乎全為藍色陰性，陽性 T 細胞只散在於濾泡間區與生發中心內；與 CD5 在外套層強陽性對照，表示外套層的 CD5 陽性細胞並非 T 細胞。
features: CD3-positive T cells concentrated in interfollicular/paracortical areas (upper right)
Scattered CD3-positive T cells within germinal centers
Monotonous small negative lymphocytes filling the nodules
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 shows that the monotonous small lymphocytes filling the expanded mantle zones are negative. CD3-positive T cells are confined to interfollicular regions and scattered within germinal centers. Compared with the CD5 stain, which labels the mantle zone population, this demonstrates aberrant CD5 expression on non-T (B) cells, supporting mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is also CD3-negative CD5+ but CD23+ LEF1+ with proliferation centers and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Reactive mantles are also CD3-negative, but their B cells lack CD5 co-expression and cyclin D1.
